Moss's 30 September strategic digest gives the ticket as **#8841**. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group about drivers at the Newark facility being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. Your own 1 July post in #strategic-pod also says you closed **#8841** with support, and that one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and the kiosk tablet cache issue. The same number on two unrelated issues looks like a mix-up, either in the digest or in the old post. I can't see the account ticket files, so I couldn't confirm which is right. The support ticket record itself should settle it.
